The following table describes the fields for the aid_master event.
Note: This event is updated about every 5 minutes.
Field name
Description
Example value
AgentLoadFlags
Whether the sensor loaded during or after the Windows host's boot
process. This is a bitfield, and may contain more than one value.
0: The sensor loaded after startup, indicating a
newly installed or updated sensor. (For Mac and
Linux hosts, this value is always 0.)
1: The sensor loaded during the boot process,
indicating the host booted normally with the
sensor installed.
2: Used for falcon system diagnostic purposes.
3: A combination of values 0 and 1.
AgentLocalTime
The local time for the sensor in epoch format.
"1538648887.051"
AgentTimeOffset
The time since the last reboot in epoch format.
"-15967.470"
AgentVersion
The version of the sensor running on a host.
"2.0.0002.2180"
aid
The sensor ID. This value is unique to each installation of a Falcon
sensor. When a sensor is updated or reinstalled, the host gets a new
aid. In those situations, a single host could have multiple aid values
over time.
"85ae98xxxxxxd9a8f2"
aip
The sensor’s IP, as seen from the CrowdStrike cloud. This is typically
the public IP of the sensor. This helps determine the location of a
computer, depending on your network.
"#.##.#.###"
BiosManufacturer
The manufacturer of the host's BIOS.
"Phoenix Technologies LTC"
BiosVersion
The version of the host's BIOS.
"6.00"

Build number used as part of the ConfigID.
"####"

The sensor's continent, as seen from the CrowdStrike cloud.
"North America"

The system's country of origin.
"United States"
FalconGroupingTags
The host tags that were added by using the UI or API.
"win2019serversmsexcl"
FirstSeen
The first time the sensor was seen by the CrowdStrike cloud in epoch
format.
"1538648887.051"
MachineDomain
The Windows domain name to which the host is currently joined.
"XYZ.CORP"
OU
The organizational unit of the host as seen by the sensor.
Defined by system admin
PointerSize
The processor architecture (in decimal, non-hex format).
"4": 32-bit
"8": 64-bit
ProductType
The type of product (in decimal, non-hex format).
"1": Workstation
"2": Domain Controller
"3": Server
SensorGroupingTags
The host tags that were added during installation.
"Japan"
ServicePackMajor
The major version # of the OS Service Pack (in decimal, non-hex
format).
"1"
SiteName
The site name of the domain to which the host is joined.
Defined by system admin
SystemManufacturer
The host's system manufacturer.
"Dell Inc."
SystemProductName
The host's product name.
"Latitude E7240"
Time
Timestamp of when the event was received by the CrowdStrike
cloud. This is not to be confused with the time the event was
generated locally on the system (the _timeevent). This is the
timestamp of the event from the cloud's point of view. This value can
be converted to any time format and can be used for calculations.
"1538648887.051"
Timezone
The sensor's time zone, as seen from the CrowdStrike cloud.
"America/Los_Angeles"
